info.title: SWU Home Game — Web UI
info.description: Thin HTTP client surface over the frozen swu.engine contract.

schema.title: Response Auth Logout Api Auth Logout Post
Response Auth Users Api Auth Users Get
Response Auth Reset Api Auth Reset Post
Response List Bugs Api Bugs Get

post.description:
The reporter tidies their own inbox — toggles the cosmetic ``reporter_archived``
flag.  Never moves the folder, so it's independent of the admin's disk archive and
invisible to his triage view.

get.description:
Serve the report's replay bundle (game.json) so an admin can open the reported
game in the ReplayViewer (Stage 4).  Owner-or-admin, like the screenshot.

schema.title: Response Delete Game Api Games  Game Id  Delete
Response Save Game Api Games  Game Id  Save Post
Response List Saves Api Saves Get

get.description: Export a shareable, deterministic replay bundle for this game.

schema.title: Response Export Replay Api Games  Game Id  Replay Get

post.description:
Reconstruct per-step board snapshots from a replay bundle so the UI can
scrub forward/back.  Body: {"bundle": <replay bundle>} (or the bundle itself).

schema.title: Response Replay Steps Endpoint Api Replay Post

get.description:
Official decks (built-in + graduated) plus, when a bearer token is
supplied, the caller's *complete* custom decks appended and tagged
``kind="custom"``.  Anonymous callers get official decks only.

schema.title: Response List Decks Api Decks Get
Response List Custom Decks Api Decks Custom Get
Response Delete Custom Deck Api Decks Custom  Deck Id  Delete

post.description:
Granular +/- for the Explorer's fast add: bump a pool card's count by
``delta`` (a count reaching ≤0 removes it).  Over-cap is allowed (drafts) and
surfaced via the deck's derived ``errors``.

get.description:
The whole card catalog for the explorer screen, with filter facets and a
per-card ``playable`` ("Available to play") flag.

post.description:
Import a SWUDB decklist (pasted ``deck`` JSON, or a ``ref`` url/id), report
legality + which cards aren't playable yet, and write a fixture the planner
can consume.  Body: {"deck": <swudb json>} or {"ref": "<url|id>"}, "name"?.

schema.title: Response Import Swudb Api Import Swudb Post

AdminTriage.title: AdminTriage
AdminTriage.description:
All users' active threads, bucketed on the signal the admin triages on:
"does this need me to prompt Claude?".

ExplorerResponse.title: ExplorerResponse
ExplorerResponse.description: Full card catalog plus the distinct values for each filter facet.

PatchCustomDeckRequest.title: PatchCustomDeckRequest
PatchCustomDeckRequest.description:
Partial edit.  A field left out is unchanged; an explicit ``null`` on
``leader_id``/``base_id`` clears that slot.  The route uses
``model_fields_set`` to tell "omitted" from "explicitly null".

ReporterArchiveRequest.title: ReporterArchiveRequest
ReporterArchiveRequest.description: The reporter's cosmetic inbox archive toggle (never moves the folder).

Snapshot.title: Snapshot
Snapshot.description: Everything the frontend needs to render and decide what to offer next.

StepResult.title: StepResult
StepResult.description: A snapshot plus the ordered events produced by the step that led to it.
